@name: Monk
@slug: monk
@source: character_law
@realms: Essence
@prime_stats: SD, Em
@description:
 Monks are semi spell users who combine the realm of Essence with the realm of
 Arms. Their base spells deal with personal movement and the control of their
 own body and mind, while their arms capabilities are concentrated in
 unarmored, unarmed combat.
